mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% and an unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and UNRATE > 4.0, or the rank correlation between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession economic regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal improving consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances during the post-recession regime, or the rank correlation between the average of HOUST and RSAFS and 5-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force employment (PAYEMS) consistently signals improving economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or the rank correlation between PAYEMS and 60-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400, it signals a strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or the rank correlation between HOUST and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, the combination signals a deepening supply shock and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the rank correlation between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the early recovery economic regime, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances during the early recovery regime, or the rank correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
